overview: Four Legions gather for the compliance of Isstvan III. Within the fleet, old bonds come under extraordinary pressure.
synopsis: At Isstvan III, selected companies from the Sons of Horus, Emperor’s Children, Death Guard and World Eaters are sent to suppress a rebellion. Loken and Tarvitz are among those whose loyalty will be tested by what follows. In orbit, remembrancers and officers confront a fleet closing itself against dissent.

The assault becomes a betrayal when the planet is subjected to a virus bombing. Tarvitz’s warning gives some of the troops a chance to shelter. Survivors from different Legions organise a desperate defence against warriors they once regarded as brothers.
detailed: Horus gathers four Legions above Isstvan III and orders selected elements to attack the rebel city. The selection is deliberate: those sent to the surface include warriors judged unlikely to support his new allegiance. Loken, Torgaddon and many others enter the operation believing they are fighting another Imperial campaign.

Tarvitz discovers enough of the fleet’s preparations to suspect a massacre. He takes a craft to the surface and warns the deployed troops, allowing some to find sealed shelter before the virus weapons fall. The virus destroys exposed life and the subsequent firestorm consumes the atmosphere above the city.

The surviving loyalists find themselves cut off and facing their own Legions. Angron’s decision to descend and attack turns an intended swift extermination into a prolonged ground war. Tarvitz helps organise resistance across Legion boundaries while the loyalists use the ruined city to delay their attackers.

Loken and Torgaddon confront Aximand and Abaddon, bringing the division within the Mournival into direct combat. Torgaddon is killed. Loken is badly wounded and left amid the devastation. Their former brotherhood has become an expression of the larger civil war.

With the resistance consuming time and men, Horus brings the struggle to an end through further bombardment. The loyalists’ defence has exposed the betrayal and imposed a cost, even though their position is hopeless. Aboard the fleet, Keeler and her companions seek a way to escape the tightening purge.
